description: Source code for converting encoder parameters to bitstream in the AMR speech codec, including functions Int2bin and Prm2bits.

methods.name: Int2bin
methods.description: Converts an integer value to binary bits and writes to bitstream array, most significant bits first.

methods.name: Prm2bits
methods.description: Converts analysis parameters into a serial bitstream based on mode, using Int2bin for each parameter.
